status: Primary-source formation research, strict editorial/key review, content/source/audio/preservation/browser/build and production offline gates passed; native review pending.
method: Full relevant formation and meaning sections inspected on the two named publishers’ own teaching pages for each form. All examples, conversations and readings are original fictional local situations.

points.formation: Noun をもとに（して） predicate; をもとにした noun.
points.teachingChoice: Archive photographs supply a video’s material; interview notes supply its structure.
points.sourceCaution: Creation/source emphasis may overlap に基づいて; no categorical exclusion. Formation questions fix the requested modifier. Publisher labels are not official assignments.

points.form: Channel or extent: を通じて / を通して
points.formation: Noun + を通じて / を通して.
points.teachingChoice: Ren is an intermediary; a separate year-long example is an extent; the quoted spelling fixes the reading task.
points.sourceCaution: N1et explicitly permits 一年を通して. Preferences in Bunpro are not a universal ban or mutually exclusive meaning. Publisher labels differ.

points.form: Issue under discussion: をめぐって / をめぐる
points.formation: Noun をめぐって / をめぐり predicate; をめぐる noun.
points.teachingChoice: The former cinema site is the focus of differing proposals in a formal report sentence explicitly read aloud.
points.sourceCaution: More marked than everyday について; no claim that every occurrence entails a hostile dispute. The independent teacher’s stronger restrictions are not universal prohibitions. No source exercise copied.

points.formation: Noun をはじめ（として） clause; をはじめとする noun.
points.teachingChoice: Residents are named as part of a wider participant list, with shop owners and students.
points.sourceCaution: Inclusion does not imply chronological speaking order. The modifier form is constrained in the task. Bunpro N3 and Tanosuke N2 labels differ.

editorialReview.sceneChoice: A familiar bakery documentary and a report handover. The formal debate/participant sentence is explicitly read aloud, with ordinary colleague speech around it; headwords are supplementary study rather than a dialogue quota.
editorialReview.remaining: Whole N2 core review after unit 16 and independent native sentence/listening review.

uninspected: Guessed Bunpro 通じて-only and hiragana めぐって URLs failed; valid combined 通じて-通して and 巡って pages used instead. No contents of those failed pages claimed.
